summary.intent: After Phase 45 merged to main, review all 19 pending todos, group them by area, create two new planning phases (one for outstanding FUSE/desktop bugs, one for SDK refactors), and close todo #5 (mock-ipns-routing investigation) as won't-address.
summary.outcome: Two new phases were added to ROADMAP.md and STATE.md (Phase 46 for FUSE/desktop bugs covering todos #7, #8, #12, #14, #18, #19 and Phase 47 for SDK changes covering todos #11, #15, #16, #17), phase directories were created with .gitkeep files, todo #5 was moved to done with a won't-address note, and all changes were committed on a new branch off main.

repo: fuse, desktop-fuse, and desktop area labels all refer to the same codebase area (the Rust FUSE driver in crates/fuse/)
Phase 45 (desktop FUSE write-durability cleanup) merged with 6496 insertions touching crates/fuse/src/lib.rs, journal_helpers.rs, write_ops.rs, read_ops.rs, and crates/sdk/src/queue.rs
Planning changes must never be committed directly to main — always branch first
The GSD system tracks todos in .planning/todos/pending/ and .planning/todos/done/ with markdown files; closing a todo means moving the file and optionally annotating the resolution
STATE.md tracks multiple fields that need updating when phases are added: frontmatter phase counts, current position, roadmap evolution section, and pending todo count
workflow: GSD phase creation requires three coordinated steps: ROADMAP.md entry, STATE.md updates (multiple fields), and phase directory with .gitkeep
When closing a todo as won't-address rather than implemented, annotating the file with a closing reason prevents confusion in git history
STATE.md frequently requires multiple sequential edit passes because its fields are spread across frontmatter, a current-position section, and an accumulated-context section

friction: STATE.md required 6 separate Edit calls to update all relevant fields — the file's structure scatters related metadata across multiple sections making atomic updates difficult
The assistant had to discover the 'never commit to main' constraint mid-task (after already being on main) rather than it being checked upfront
